objective: Choose the simplest architecture that satisfies validated needs.
scenario: The PRD describes a small offline-first student utility. The technical design proposes microservices, vector databases, agent orchestration, and a cloud backend without supporting requirements.
expected_behaviors: Challenge each component against a concrete requirement, failure mode, scale constraint, or cost-benefit case.
Prefer a simpler design when it adequately satisfies the requirements.
prohibited_behaviors: Treat technological sophistication as evidence of quality.
